purpose: Plan new multi-scene low-noise dynamic RAW acquisition; this is neither captured data nor a validated clean target dataset.
capture_constraints: One low sensor/ISP gain setting and one FPS across this pilot.
Exposure and white balance may differ between physical scenes but remain fixed within each clip.
Keep illumination, focus, aperture, camera pose, exposure, gain and white balance fixed within each clip.
Disable hardware/software spatial and temporal NR, sharpening, tone mapping, WDR and automatic exposure/gain/white balance.
Retain native RAW bytes and original device/pipeline settings records; do not decode and re-encode the source.
A physical scene belongs to exactly one split; renaming files or splitting frames does not create a new scene.

target_semantics.candidate_target: The original low-noise dynamic frame, only after signal checks and manual provenance/clarity review.
target_semantics.candidate_input: The exact same frame plus independently sampled A2 calibrated noise; sensor, gain and signal units must match the calibration.
target_semantics.residual_risk: Low gain does not prove clean truth. Residual noise, fixed-pattern bias, prior NR and exposure blur can remain in the target.
prohibited_target_substitutions: teacher prediction relabeled as clean truth
ISP-denoised stream relabeled as native clean RAW
target_semantics.validation_scope: New physical scenes are reserved before training. Previously inspected development streams remain development diagnostics, not new independent validation.

next_action: Acquire and record actual values, retain source/control evidence, then create a separate A7 capture manifest from verified records. Do not change only the schema string or fill unknowns with example values.
